Transform an expression matrix to long table

Source: R/AllGenerics.R, R/AllMethods.R
exprsToLong.Rd

Transform an expression matrix to long table

exprsToLong(x, ...)

# S4 method for class 'matrix'
exprsToLong(
  x,
  idvar = "illID",
  timevar = "hybridID",
  valuevar = "value",
  ids = rownames(x),
  valueType = "raw"
)

# S4 method for class 'eSet'
exprsToLong(x)

Arguments

x

A matrix or an ExpressionSet object

...

Other parameters

idvar

Variable name of the feature identifier, passed to reshape

timevar

The time variable, passed to reshape

valuevar

The value variable

ids

Feature identifiers

valueType

Character string, value type

Value

A data.frame

Methods (by class)

  • matrix: The method for matrix as input

  • eSet: The method for eSet as input
